source.title: Performance Evaluation of Bagasse Fuelled Cogeneration System – The Case of Wonji-Shoa Sugar Mill
source.author: Asaye Mebratu
source.note: Small factual transcription of operating values reported as taken from the plant process control board; not a redistribution of the thesis.

do_not_treat_as_measured.reason: The thesis derives this value from a recommended steam-to-bagasse ratio of 2.4; it is not presented as a direct fuel-flow measurement.

supported: IF97 plausibility for a real bagasse-fired superheated-steam operating point
audit of calculated steam/feedwater enthalpy against published engineering values
explicit detection of the unresolved ~2.1% steam-enthalpy discrepancy instead of widening tolerance
not_supported: using the published steam enthalpy as an IF97 golden until the pressure/temperature/table basis discrepancy is resolved
full boiler efficiency reproduction from this snapshot
fuel-to-steam balance using the derived bagasse rate as if it were measured
